answer_sql:
SELECT
  c.country_name,
  AVG(order_total) AS avg_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    s.sale_country_code,
    s.order_key,
    SUM(s.net_amount) AS order_total
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.sale_country_code,
    s.order_key
) AS o
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS c
  ON o.sale_country_code = c.country_code
WHERE
  c.is_placeholder = FALSE
GROUP BY
  c.country_name
HAVING
  AVG(order_total) > 500
ORDER BY
  avg_order_value DESC

Every sales line in v_contoso5_sales_line, both channels (online and physical, per Order.channel default), all dates (no period restriction, per Order.period default). Orders identified by distinct order_key, with net_amount (per Order.revenue_means_net) summed per order then averaged per country. Country is by sale_country_code (territory attribution, per Country.whose default). The placeholder country '--' is excluded per Country.rows default (is_placeholder = false). The HAVING clause filters to countries where average order-level net_amount > 500 USD — all 8 real countries pass.
